points.description: Names all three service classes: unconfirmed connectionless, confirmed connectionless, and connection-oriented.
points.partial_credit: Half if only two classes are named correctly.

points.description: Explains unconfirmed connectionless: no acknowledgements, data loss possible, no flow control, no connect/disconnect.
points.partial_credit: Half if only no-ACK/loss is given without other differences, or stated vaguely.

points.description: Explains confirmed connectionless: each frame is acknowledged, so loss is handled by timeout and retransmission (duplicates/sequence errors possible), still no flow control and no connection setup.
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'with ACK' is stated without the retransmission or the lack of connection/flow control.

points.description: Explains connection-oriented: no loss, duplication or sequencing errors; three phases (connect, data transfer, disconnect) with flow control.
points.partial_credit: Half if only connection setup/teardown or only reliability is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the three class names and a correct distinguishing explanation of each (ACK use, reliability, connection phases, flow control). Give part marks for names with vague or incomplete differences, or for explanations missing one key feature. A wrong statement about a class loses that class's mark only; a list of names with no differences gets about 0.25–0.5.
